authoredNote: Lines computed from `nl -ba` of the committed fixture; the positive rows pin BOTH metadata.owner and metadata.ownerEvidence, and the negative row pins the ABSENT case (`meta.owner: null`) so an over-claim fails just as loudly as a miss.
rationale: PINS THE FACTORY-RETURN CLASS: a same-file callable with an ANNOTATED return type states the local's type, evidence `factory`. The negative is the un-annotated twin (`function makeUnannotated() { return new Widget() }`): its call must carry NO owner — inference from a body is not this class's evidence, and a row that claimed Widget there would be a guess. Both halves are one edit apart, so a rule that over-reaches fails.
